description: Aaron Buhrmann at GFZ publishes BEAM-based building exposure estimates for Ahrweiler, Germany. The June 2025 deposit provides GeoPackage and CSV outputs for more than 60,000 buildings, freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The README describes allocating net asset values by building volume, economic sector and asset category, including residential, industrial, service and agricultural uses. These estimates can supply spatial exposure and replacement-value inputs to flood-loss simulations. They are modelled allocations, not individually appraised property values. Price year, valuation units and uncertainty require further confirmation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this regional output. The README’s draft-paper placeholders are not treated as an established citation. Only metadata and the text README were inspected; the building tables and linked processing scripts were not executed.
